audit.grading_census: All 49 admitted RADON-B rows carry the identical FEATURE formula 'Type according to Rosenstock: [site-type word]; name of the layer: X' (FEATURETYPE census: enclosure 35, tell 12, settlement 2). No admitted row names a sample feature. A site-type word is the same evidence class as the baseline's non-grading 'feature_type: settlement' strings, and a layer name is the same class R1 held non-grading at Qasim Bagh; the rows therefore stay unassessed, uniformly, including the 15 in-window rows (Aq Kupruk II 1, Amri 2, Balakot 4, Damp Sadaat 2, Mehrgarh 1, Rana Ghundai 1, Mundigak 4). The full strings are preserved verbatim in each row's context_description.
audit.coordinate_assertion_note: RADON-B asserts latitude 29.3 / longitude 67.5 for all 24 of its Mehrgarh records (source: Rosenstock2009). Published site references place Mehrgarh at the Bolan Pass (approx. 29.8 N, 64.6 E); the asserted pair is carried AS PUBLISHED per the frozen trace-or-don't-build rule (the build mints no coordinates of its own), the conflict is recorded here and in the Phase-394 outcome record, and the pair is inside the frozen box either way, so no filter outcome depends on it. Every other admitted site's asserted coordinates check against its published location (Balakot, Mundigak, Amri, Quetta-valley and Loralai sites, Aq Kupruk).

targets.target: Petrie, Bates, Higham & Singh 2016 (Antiquity 90(354)) + Online Supplementary Material
targets.disposition: LOCATED AND DATA-BEARING. The paper is CC BY-NC-ND open access (author manuscript + supplement in the Cambridge Apollo repository); posture open_access_read_only. The supplement's Tables S4-S7 publish 28 AMS determinations for Masudpur VII and Masudpur I with trench + numbered context per sample, dated material (taxon) per sample, and the authors' own quality flags (intrusive / problematic / inaccurate) — every determination extracted in full (see audit.extracted_not_admitted). The supplement's Table S2 types the Masudpur VII contexts (Fill, Pit fill, Ash fill, Surface, Collapse): under the frozen grading rule the samples' contexts are named, typed excavation contexts, so the determinations WOULD grade associated.

NOT ADMITTED IN THIS BUILD — coordinates. Masudpur I and VII are new sites (not in the frozen gazetteer, not in the spine). The publications reached (paper, supplement, Bates 2016 thesis) state no site coordinates, and no published coordinate source for Bhim Wada Jodha / Sampolia Khera was found in the geographic authorities checked (Pleiades, Wikidata, OpenStreetMap). Rule 7 admits coordinate-less rows only for gazetteer-established sites; inventing or estimating coordinates is not available to this build. The full extraction is preserved in this record so a future build (or a Spec 027 gazetteer act) can admit the rows without re-extraction.

AUDITED: carries the same Masudpur determinations in thesis tables (its Tables 7.1/7.2 match OSM S7/S6) and classes the two OxA-X determinations as unreliable — corroborating the flags carried here. No additional determinations and no site coordinates.
